description: Nonlinear system with known Koopman eigenfunctions (2D), backward reachability over a finite horizon, unreachable, box sets.
notes: Backward reachability benchmark: trajectories follow the time-reversed flow dx/dt = -f(x) from initial_sets. It shows that eigenfunction-based reach-time bounds handle backward problems by negating the eigenvalues (the eigenfunctions of -f are those of f). It is equivalent to the forward problem with initial_sets and target_sets exchanged.
